item.title: Open weights week: 12 new models released under Apache 2.0
item.description: This week the hub added 12 new open-weight models, most under Apache 2.0, including a 7B multimodal model and three distilled speech models with sub-200ms latency.

item.title: Leaderboard update: agentic tool-use splits from chat quality
item.description: The tool-use leaderboard now reports multi-step reliability separately: only 4 of 38 models finish a 50-step task with more than 70% success.
